name: Elevated Pigeon Stretch
instructions: Place your shin on a bench or box, knee bent about 90 degrees.
Square your hips toward the surface as best you can.
Hinge forward gently over the front leg until you feel a deep glute stretch.
Keep the spine long and hold 30-60 seconds per side, breathing into the stretch.
cues: Stay relaxed outside the target area
longevityNotes: Mobility is use-it-or-lose-it. Ten minutes of daily joint work preserves the ranges that keep you independent — reaching, bending, and getting up from the floor.
overview: Elevated Pigeon Stretch is a beginner mobility exercise for the glutes, performed with just your bodyweight. Regular mobility work keeps joints moving freely and makes strength training safer.
